resources.string: In a few steps we make the tablet yours: Home, system tools, automatic updates, performance and look. Every step can be skipped and redone any time from Settings.
NOVA Home becomes the tablet\'s first screen: all apps in alphabetical order, favourites, the wave alphabet. Your previous launcher stays installed and you can switch back any time.
Shizuku gives NOVA system permissions without root: silent updates, optimisations, turning the screen off from Home. Every change is logged and can be undone.
If Shizuku is not running: Developer options → Wireless debugging, then follow the Shizuku notification.
With the GitHub token NOVA receives every improvement by itself and can go back to a previous version. The token stays encrypted on the tablet and only goes to GitHub.
NOVA measures in a few seconds how fast the tablet is and picks the best graphics level by itself: nice animations without stutter.
Pick a theme to start with. Then in Settings → Home → Customise you can change background, colours, fonts, icons and gestures.
NOVA is set up. To ask for an improvement or report a problem use the Improve and Repair buttons in Settings.
